mentions.name: Aftercorp
mentions.description: A VR survival horror game for Meta Quest 3/3S that uses a realtime environment mesh reconstruction algorithm to approximate the real-world 3D geometry and project a dummy flashlight via hand tracking. It runs at 60fps on a tight GPU budget, scales to different environments, and a handheld AR-style port to iOS is planned.
